description:
New to the Market 
Outstanding 3 Bedroom Stone-Cut Dormer Bungalow with Lake Views
Shanvallyard, Tourmakeady, Co. Mayo – F12 R891

Guide Price: €475,000

Nigel Dineen & Martin Finn Auctioneers are proud to present this exceptional 3-bedroom detached stone-cut dormer bungalow, complete with a large detached garage/workshop with attic space suitable for home office or additional accommodation.

Set on an elevated site overlooking the stunning Lough Mask, this property comes to the market in true showhouse condition, offering a rare combination of luxury, tranquillity and breathtaking natural surroundings.

Located just a 1-minute walk from Lough Mask Harbour, renowned for its world-class trout and pike fishing, this property is ideal for those seeking a lifestyle home in one of Mayo’s most scenic locations.

Accommodation Comprises:

Entrance Hall:
Tiled flooring, feature lighting and hotpress.

Open Plan Kitchen / Dining / Living Area:
A truly impressive space featuring a vaulted high timber ceiling, creating exceptional light and openness, with panoramic views of Lough Mask.

Finished with tiled flooring, an original Swedish multi-fuel stove with stone and brick backdrop, feature lighting, fitted kitchen units and additional windows maximising natural light and lake views.

Bedrooms:
Bedroom 1: Timber flooring, fitted curtains with views to rear mountains

Bedroom 2: Timber flooring, fitted curtains with views of Lough Mask

Bedroom 3 (Upstairs): Timber flooring and ceiling, fitted curtains, Stira stairs to attic

Bathrooms:
Main Bathroom: Fully tiled floor and walls, white suite, plumbed shower, mirror and shaver light

Ensuite: WC, WHB, electric shower (fully tiled), skylight

First Floor:
Mezzanine Landing: Overlooking the kitchen/dining area, ideal for home office or additional living space

Outside & Additional Buildings:
Detached Garage / Workshop (c.13m x 10m):
Double block construction
Insulated with radon barrier
ESB and water connected

Electric roller door with side access
Attic space with stairs – ideal for home office or accommodation
Skylights installed

Grounds & Features:
Elevated site with uninterrupted views of Lough Mask

Mature gardens front and rear with hedging

Natural stream running alongside property flowing to the lake

Hardcore driveway
Septic tank

Mains water
Fibre broadband available

Additional Features:
Vaulted ceiling in main living area enhancing space and light

Oil-Fired Central Heating System
Triple glazed windows

PVC composite front door
Showhouse condition throughout

Location:
1 minute walk to Lough Mask Harbour
Approx. 5 minutes to Tourmakeady Village
Approx. 20 km to Westport
Close to Ballinrobe, Cong and Castlebar

This is a rare opportunity to acquire a premium lakeside residence offering privacy, lifestyle and exceptional natural beauty.
